definitions.explanation: The area near or surrounding a place.
Used to indicate an approximate location, time, or amount.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{辺|あた}り⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{静|しず}かだ→静か：00755_shizuka⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{辺|あた}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ありますか→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Is there a bank around here?

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{辺|あた}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{待|ま}っているので→待つ：00469_matsu⟧、⟦{着|つ}いたら→着く：00680_tsuku⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}してください→電話：01471_denwa⟧。
examples.english: I'll be waiting near the station, so please call when you arrive.
I think they'll come around 3 o'clock.
You can buy it for around 1,000 yen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧{辺|あた}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧⟦{会|あ}って→会う：00482_au⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しません→する：00392_suru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Shall we meet up around next week and talk?

notes:
{辺|あた}り has two main uses: indicating a physical vicinity (sense 1) and indicating approximation of time, amount, or location (sense 2). It is very common in everyday conversation.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{辺|あた}り: around here
- ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{辺|あた}り: near ~, around ~
- 3⟦{時|じ}→〜時：09869_ji⟧{辺|あた}り: around 3 o'clock
- 1000⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧{辺|あた}り: around 1,000 yen
- ⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧{辺|あた}り: around next week

WRITING:
Often written in hiragana as あたり, especially in casual contexts. The kanji {辺|あた}り is standard; {周|あた}り (emphasizing surroundings) is an alternative.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{近|ちか}く→近く：00923_chikaku⟧: nearby (more specific about closeness)
- ⟦{付近|ふきん}→付近：00044_fukin⟧: vicinity (more formal)
- ⟦ぐらい→ぐらい：02900_gurai⟧/⟦くらい→くらい：noentry⟧: about, approximately (for quantities and time, but not places)

WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse with ⟦{当|あ}たり→当たり：01919_atari⟧ (hit, success, winning) — same reading, different kanji.
